subject: geography
title: Conflict & Cooperation
meta_desc: A-Level Geography AQA adventure on conflict, UN peacekeeping and global cooperation.

concepts.def: UN-mandated missions to monitor ceasefires; 100000+ personnel deployed.
Forced migrant across international border (1951 Convention).
Internally Displaced Person; doesn't cross border; 71 million globally 2022.
Responsibility to Protect; 2005 doctrine for atrocity prevention.
North Atlantic Treaty Organization, 32 members, collective defence (Article 5).
Cannot provide basic services; Somalia, South Sudan examples.

walkthroughs.body_html: 16 active missions in 2024; budget $6.4 billion. MONUSCO (DRC) is largest. Successes: Cambodia (1992-93), Sierra Leone (2005). Failures: Rwanda 1994 (800000 deaths), Srebrenica 1995. Peacekeepers from 121 countries; Bangladesh largest contributor.

UNHCR 2022: 108 million displaced globally. Syria conflict displaced 13 million (50 percent of pre-war population); 6.5 million refugees, 7 million IDPs. Turkey hosts 3.7 million; largest refugee-host country. 2015 European migration crisis: 1 million arrivals.

Russian invasion February 2022; UN General Assembly condemned 141-5. ICC arrest warrant for Putin (March 2023). EU/US sanctions; Russia removed from Council of Europe. Refugees: 8 million Ukrainians in Europe; 6 million IDPs. UN Black Sea grain deal failed July 2023.
